native.someip_edition: Actual selected wire rules and qualified implementation edition.
native.someip_proposal_mode: Actual interface configuration versus explicitly selected source proposals; confirmed values are preserved.
native.someip_transport: Actual UDP datagram, TCP byte stream or SOME/IP-TP over UDP; no assumed Ethernet PHY.
native.someip_role: Actual sender versus receiver; reserved bits must be zero on sending and ignored on reception.
native.someip_message: Actual ordinary RPC/event or directional TCP resynchronization cookie.
native.someip_message_type: Actual base type; wire TP flag represented separately.
native.someip_payload_order: Configured payload scalar byte order; structural length/tag fields remain big endian.
native.someip_header_order: Actual header and TP header byte order.
native.someip_structural_order: Actual length/tag/union-selector byte order, independent from payload scalar order.
native.someip_serialization: Actual interface standard serialization versus extensible TLV tags.
native.someip_array_kind: Selected fixed versus dynamic array; dynamic requires length field.
native.someip_string_kind: Selected fixed versus dynamic string; dynamic requires length field.
native.someip_string_encoding: Selected Unicode wire encoding under interface description.
native.someip_outcome: Actual application/transaction result, not inferred from delivery on TCP.
native.someip_protocol_version: Wire header format version1 under audited edition; not service major version.
native.someip_interface_version: Actual service interface major version; incompatible payload changes require explicit matching.
native.someip_expected_interface_version: Actual receiving service interface major version.
native.someip_service_id: Configured service identity; no universal default or assumed service instance.
native.someip_method_id: Actual method/event identity; recommended split is separate policy, not a mandatory global ID limit.
native.someip_client_id: Actual calling client identity; notifications carry zero, cookie has distinct value.
native.someip_session_id: Actual zero when inactive,1..65535 when active; responses copy outstanding request.
native.someip_expected_client_id: Actual outstanding request client identity for response/error correlation.
native.someip_expected_session_id: Actual outstanding request session identity for response/error correlation.
native.someip_wire_type: Actual header message type code including TP bit0x20.
native.someip_return_code: Actual8-bit code; only E_OK0 for requests/notifications, ERROR cannot carry0; service-specific codes need source.
native.someip_length_bytes: Actual32-bit length begins with request ID: payload+8, or segment+12 for TP. Not total16-byte-header message size.
native.someip_message_bytes: Actual SOME/IP message size including16-byte header and optional4-byte TP header.
native.someip_udp_budget_bytes: Actual available UDP payload budget from qualified IP/header/security/path configuration; no CAN frame cap.
native.someip_datagram_bytes: Actual full UDP data bytes including all concatenated SOME/IP messages.
native.someip_accumulation_bytes: Actual aggregate bytes of additional serialized SOME/IP messages in the same datagram.
native.someip_alignment: Actual byte alignment after non-final variable element; TLV only1-byte alignment.
native.someip_array_length_bytes: Configured array length field width; fixed0/1/2/4, dynamic1/2/4.
native.someip_string_length_bytes: Configured string length field width; fixed0/1/2/4, dynamic1/2/4.
native.someip_struct_length_bytes: Configured struct length field width0/1/2/4; TLV requires nonzero inherited width.
native.someip_union_length_bytes: Configured union length field width0/1/2/4; TLV shares nonzero top-level width.
native.someip_union_selector_bytes: Configured union selector field width1/2/4, encoded big endian.
native.someip_top_length_bytes: TLV top-level inherited length field width1/2/4, no member override.
native.someip_tp_segment_bytes: Actual data in this TP segment;1392-byte aligned maximum is recommended, not universal datagram cap.
native.someip_tp_offset_bytes: Actual reassembled data byte offset, multiple16.
native.someip_tp_original_bytes: Actual original serialized SOME/IP payload length excluding16-byte SOME/IP header.
native.someip_tp_buffer_bytes: Actual configured reception buffer cap; not assumed65535 or transport MTU.
native.someip_tp_reserved: Actual three TP reserved bits, sender zero while receiver ignores value.
native.someip_tp_reassembly_timeout_s: Configured timeout between received segments; no universal factory value.
native.someip_tp_separation_s: CP configured minimum spacing between bursts, strictly positive; not request timeout.
native.someip_tp_budget_s: CP qualified route/software jitter budget added to separation for receive timeout.
native.someip_tp_burst_size: CP number of segments sent without separation, source default1; no memory budget inferred.
native.someip_tp_gap_s: Actual observed interval since previous received segment.
native.someip_tp_unique_received_bytes: Actual complete non-overlapping reconstructed bytes; duplicate counting cannot prove completeness.
native.someip_e2e_offset_bits: Actual E2E header offset from RequestID; source default64bits positions it after return code.
native.someip_e2e_header_bytes: Actual independent E2E-profile header length, already included in serialized payload.
native.someip_response_timeout_s: Actual application method timeout; no universal100ms/CAN timing default.
native.someip_network_bound_ms: Actual full selected UDP/TCP path, queue/segmentation/recovery bound.
native.someip_e2e_bound_ms: Actual source+network+consumer chain, independent from E2E protection header.
native.someip_age_ms: Actual correlated sample/event age at consumer.
native.someip_session_active: Actual configured session handling, required RPC and allTP.
native.someip_tp_more: Actual more-segments flag; nonfinal segment must align16bytes.
native.someip_tp_flag: Actual wire segmentation flag, valid onlyUDP_TP.
native.someip_tlv_dynamic_width: Actual TLV length selection by wire type; static inherited width still required.
native.someip_tcp_nodelay: Configured Nagle disabling recommended to reduce latency, not proof of deadline.
native.someip_ip_fragmentation: Actual separately qualified IP fragmentation use, permitted by protocol but not assumed loss-free.
native.someip_e2e_protected: Actual independent E2E protection applied; not proof of safety certification.
native.someip_e2e_verified: Actual independent selected E2E profile and result qualified.
native.someip_binding_verified: Actual endpoint/service-instance/port/role and all lower-layer bindings validated.
native.someip_codec_verified: Actual complete type/width/length/TLV/padding/encoding byte layout validated.
native.someip_tp_complete: Actual complete correctly reassembled original payload.
native.someip_tp_sender_overlap: Actual sender overlap/duplicate detected; forbidden for conforming transmission.
native.someip_data_accepted: Actual independent application consumer acceptance, not wire-level E_OK alone.
native.someip_binding_source: Actual canonical service instance,endpoint,address,port and selected lower-layer path.
native.someip_interface_source: Actual service major version,type map,events/methods/client/session assignment.
native.someip_codec_source: Actual serializer layout/length bounds/Unicode/TLV alignment, no generic data guessing.
native.someip_transport_source: Actual UDP/IP budget or TCP stream/recovery resources and independent PHY capacity.
native.someip_return_code_source: Actual interface-specific error allocation when code exceeds generic error space.
native.payload_bytes: Actual serialized SOME/IP application payload including independently selected E2E protection bytes, separate16-byte SOME/IP header,4-byte TP header, UDP aggregate/IP budget and TCP byte stream. No CAN8-byte or universal65535-byte payload cap.
